CustomField.description: One field API path per line to display on each pending item in the customApprovalInbox LWC. Supports dot notation for relationships (e.g. Agreement__r.Name). Fields are resolved from the target object at runtime.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter one field API path per line. Use dot notation for relationships, e.g. Agreement__r.Name or Status__c.
CustomField.label: Inbox Display Fields
